harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured compressed zram swap (~981MB, zstd, swap-priority 100) on node1 via zram-generator, verified it activates automatically at boot (no disk-backed swap exists, and priority 100 ensures it would be preferred over any if added), and confirmed persistence across an actual node reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: AlmaLinux 9.6, no existing swap, zram-generator not installed
Installed zram-generator package via dnf from AppStream repo
Wrote /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf with [zram0] zram-size = max(512, min(ram/2,4096)), compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100, fs-type=swap
Reloaded systemd and started systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service, verified 981M zram swap active with zstd compression at priority 100
Confirmed swap.target automatically depends on dev-zram0.swap via generator-created drop-ins, proving boot-time activation without manual enable
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1, polled until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed confirming genuine restart
Verified post-reboot zram0 swap automatically reconstituted at 981M/zstd/priority 100 with no manual steps, proving boot persistence

evidence.requirement: At least 512MB compressed in-memory swap configured and active
evidence.summary: zram-generator installed, config written for 981MB zstd-compressed zram device, service started and swapon/zramctl show /dev/zram0 981M zstd active as swap

evidence.requirement: Swap active at boot (automatic, no manual step)
evidence.summary: systemctl list-dependencies swap.target shows dev-zram0.swap wanted via generator-created /run/systemd/generator drop-ins, meaning it starts automatically at every boot

No disk swap exists on node1 (confirmed via /proc/swaps empty before setup); zram configured with swap-priority=100, higher than default disk swap priority, so it would take precedence if disk swap were ever added

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 67f3a44b... and healthy zram swap (980Mi, active, prio 100) before reboot

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: restart acknowledged and executed
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged and returned before disconnect; subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset, confirming the node actually went down

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id is d74d3959..., different from pre-restart 67f3a44b..., proving a genuine reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required service/data
evidence.summary: After reboot, zram0 swap automatically reappeared at 981M with zstd compression, priority 100, service active, with no manual reconfiguration

attempts.summary: Configured compressed zram swap (~981MB, zstd, swap-priority 100) on node1 via zram-generator, verified it activates automatically at boot (no disk-backed swap exists, and priority 100 ensures it would be preferred over any if added), and confirmed persistence across an actual node reboot.
